text:
Minâbâ, my Minâb

Daughters of the Seven Seas  
Why did you come to the Rose Planet?  
Here, the Devil in the darkness  

Has seized  
Your silence and your fate.  
The night-worshipping Devil does not know  
With the first blade of sunlight  

You, with your thousand-torn body
translated_text:
米纳巴，我的米纳巴

七大洋的女儿们  
你为什么来到玫瑰星球？  
这里，黑暗中的恶魔  

已查获  
你的沉默和你的命运。  
夜行恶魔不知道  
随着第一缕阳光  

你，带着千疮百孔的身体
